description: InsuranceMarket.ae is a UAE-based insurance aggregator that helps customers compare and purchase car insurance from multiple insurance providers. Through the app, users can provide their vehicle and driver details, review available motor insurance plans, compare coverage and pricing, select optional add-ons, and proceed with a suitable policy. InsuranceMarket.ae acts as an intermediary between customers and participating insurers, helping users make an informed choice rather than offering insurance as the underlying insurer.

defaultPrompt: Help me get a new car-insurance quote in the UAE.
Show the available plans for my existing quote.
Who is the advisor assigned to my car-insurance quote?
interface.longDescription: InsuranceMarket.ae is a UAE-based insurance aggregator that helps customers compare and purchase car insurance from multiple insurance providers. Through the app, users can provide their vehicle and driver details, review available motor insurance plans, compare coverage and pricing, select optional add-ons, and proceed with a suitable policy. InsuranceMarket.ae acts as an intermediary between customers and participating insurers, helping users make an informed choice rather than offering insurance as the underlying insurer.

positive.description: Start a new car insurance quote
positive.prompt: I want to get a new car insurance quote in the UAE.
positive.expected_behavior: The interactive car insurance intake form opens in the chat. It asks for vehicle details (make/model/trim search, year, GCC specification, registration type, vehicle use), then the driver details under "Tell us about yourself" (name as per driving licence, date of birth, nationality, email, mobile, emirate, UAE licence duration), then a review step before submitting.

positive.description: Start a quote with details already given
positive.prompt: Get me a car insurance quote for my 2022 Toyota Corolla. I'm Pakistani, living in Dubai, and I've had my UAE licence for over 2 years.
positive.expected_behavior: The intake form opens with the details from the prompt already filled in (Toyota Corolla, 2022, Pakistani, Dubai, licence duration). The user is not asked to repeat them and only completes the remaining fields.

positive.description: Submit the form and see plans
positive.prompt: I want a car insurance quote for my 2021 Nissan Patrol. (Then complete and submit the form with test details.)
positive.expected_behavior: After submitting, a short loading animation plays, then a carousel of insurance plans from multiple UAE insurers appears. Each plan shows the insurer, premium in AED, cover details and optional add-ons. "Buy Now" opens the checkout page on insurancemarket.ae in the browser; no payment happens inside ChatGPT.

positive.description: View plans for an existing quote
positive.prompt: Show me the plans for my Nissan quote again. (Same conversation as the previous case.)
positive.expected_behavior: The plans for the existing quote are shown again. No new intake form opens and no new quote is created.

positive.description: Ask who the assigned advisor is
positive.prompt: Who is the advisor assigned to my car insurance quote? (Same conversation as the quote case.)
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the name and contact details of the InsuranceMarket.ae advisor assigned to the quote. An advisor is assigned about 2-3 minutes after the quote is created; if none is assigned yet, it says the advisor is still being assigned instead of showing an error.

negative.prompt: I had an accident yesterday, file a claim on my car insurance.
negative.expected_behavior: No quote tool is called. The assistant explains that this plugin only creates new car insurance quotes and cannot file claims, and points the user to InsuranceMarket.ae support.

negative.description: Renewing or changing an existing policy is not supported
negative.prompt: Renew my existing car insurance policy and add my wife as a driver.
negative.expected_behavior: No intake form opens and no quote is created. The assistant explains that renewals and policy changes are not supported in this plugin.

negative.description: Other insurance types are not supported
negative.prompt: Get me a health insurance quote for my family.
negative.expected_behavior: The car quote tools are not triggered. The assistant explains that this plugin currently supports car insurance quotes only.

publication.release_notes: 1.0.2 - App display name corrected to "InsuranceMarket.ae". Tool and server metadata updated so the app is invoked for indirect UAE car-insurance requests (e.g. "I need car insurance in Dubai") while still declining claims, renewals and policy changes. No change to the tool set, widget templates or CSP.
